title: MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update: Air New Zealand IFR, Berlin Airlift & Route 66!
description:
Looking to take your visual exploration and route flying to the next level in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024? The Marketplace just rolled out a fresh wave of structured airline rotations, historic aviation corridors, transcontinental overland odysseys, and low-and-slow canyon adventures. Whether you want to fly line routes across New Zealand in an Airbus airliner or retrace iconic overland pathways, this week's drop brings hours of guided flying adventures!

In this activity breakdown, we organize the latest marketplace arrivals into clear categories to help you decide what's claiming top priority in your flight log:

✈️ COMMERCIAL AIRLINE ROTATIONS
We kick off with Perfect Flight’s 12 Legs ANZ (Air New Zealand Summer 2026) package for the Airbus A320neo v2. Featuring an official Air New Zealand livery, this pack delivers 12 structured IFR airline rotations connecting Auckland to Christchurch, Hamilton, Dunedin, Wellington, Queenstown, and regional hubs across the North and South Islands—backed by authentic aviation stances and over 100 monitored flight events.

🎖️ AVIATION HISTORY EXPEDITIONS
Ready to step back in time and hand-fly historic flight paths? Koschi introduces 75 Years Airlift Berlin, commemorating the massive humanitarian airbridge that supplied West Berliners during the Soviet blockade. We explore its three dedicated air corridor missions through the Soviet occupation zone into Tempelhof, custom scenery, historic navaids, and "Candy Bomber" liveries (with an essential buyer tip on base aircraft requirements). Next, we trace 100 Years of the Mother Road with Koschi's Route 66 expedition, guiding you across 2,480 road miles (1,830 nautical miles) and 99 waypoints from Chicago to Los Angeles with fully selectable weather, time, and ATC integration.

🏞️ THE BEAUTIFUL CANYONS BUSH SERIES
For low-and-slow bush pilots, Koschi delivers The Beautiful Canyons Series across Parts 1 through 4. We examine the stunning deep-gorge legs across the Black Canyon of the Gunnison, Blyde River Canyon, Waimea Canyon, and Barranca del Cobre. We also look at the complete series bundle and explain why picking up the multi-pack is the smartest move for your sim budget.

🌸 CULTURAL & SCENIC DISCOVERY
Looking to explore the Land of the Rising Sun? Koschi presents All the Sights of Japan, taking full advantage of the sim's streamed photogrammetry, 65 points of interest (POIs), and 20 areas of interest (AOIs) across coastal shorelines and iconic mountain peaks.

Which of these new activities are you loading up first? Flying commercial IFR legs across New Zealand in the A320neo, threading historic Soviet corridors into Tempelhof, or cruising low along Route 66? Let us know in the comments below!

If this marketplace guide helped you find your next flight adventure in MSFS 2024, remember to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel for weekly sim coverage, and blue skies on your next flight!
